featureFocus: Poll and Survey Creation and Response
documentationReport:
The feature cluster "Poll and Survey Creation and Response" in the Xikolo application primarily revolves around the `PollsController` and its associated ViewComponents and Presenters. This cluster enables users to view, vote on, and review the results of polls.

**Core Functionality:**
1.  **Displaying the Next Poll:** When a user accesses the dashboard, an AJAX request is made to `next_poll_path` [Source: app/views/dashboard/_polls.html.slim]. The `PollsController#next` action fetches the `upcoming_for_user` poll [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb] and renders it using `Dashboard::Poll::Widget` and `Dashboard::Poll::Question` ViewComponents [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb]. If no upcoming poll is found, a `no_content` header is returned [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb].
2.  **Voting on a Poll:** Users can submit their choices for a poll via the `PollsController#vote` action [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb]. This action calls `poll.vote!` with the selected choices and the `current_user.id` [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb]. After voting, the system checks for the existence of a `next_poll` [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb] and renders a `Dashboard::Poll::Thanks` ViewComponent, which can display results if `poll.reveal_results?` is true [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb].
3.  **Poll Archive and Results:** The `PollsController#archive` action retrieves the 20 latest started polls [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb]. Each poll is then processed by a `PollArchivePresenter` to prepare it for display [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb]. The `PollArchivePresenter` determines whether to show results based on the poll's `ended?` status, whether the user has `voted?`, and if `poll.reveal_results?` [Source: app/presenters/poll_archive_presenter.rb]. It also provides localized messages for intermediate or final results, or callouts if results are not yet available or the user hasn't voted [Source: app/presenters/poll_archive_presenter.rb]. Results are rendered using `Dashboard::Poll::Question.results` [Source: app/presenters/poll_archive_presenter.rb].

**Inferred Models and Components:**
*   **`Poll::Poll` (Model):** This ActiveRecord model is central to the poll functionality. It manages poll questions, options, user responses, and statistical data. It provides methods for finding upcoming polls, processing votes, and determining result visibility [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb, app/presenters/poll_archive_presenter.rb].
*   **`Poll::Option` (Model):** Represents the individual choices available for a poll question. It is included when fetching polls for the archive [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb].
*   **`Poll::Response` (Model):** Stores a user's selections for a specific poll. Its existence is checked by `PollArchivePresenter#voted?` [Source: app/presenters/poll_archive_presenter.rb].
*   **`Dashboard::Poll::Widget` (ViewComponent):** Acts as a wrapper for displaying poll content on the dashboard [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb].
*   **`Dashboard::Poll::Question` (ViewComponent):** Renders the poll question and its options, used both for voting and displaying results [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb, app/presenters/poll_archive_presenter.rb].
*   **`Dashboard::Poll::Thanks` (ViewComponent):** Displays a confirmation message after a user votes, potentially including results and a prompt for the next poll [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb].
*   **`Abstract::FrontendController` (Base Controller):** The parent class for `PollsController`, providing common functionalities like ensuring user login and setting cache headers [Source: app/controllers/polls_controller.rb].
*   **`Global::Callout` (ViewComponent/Helper):** Used by `PollArchivePresenter` to display general informational messages to the user [Source: app/presenters/poll_archive_presenter.rb].

**Relationship to Surveys (RAG Context):**
The `take_survey.feature` documentation [Source: integration/features/xikolo/content/quiz/take_survey.feature] describes a similar user interaction pattern for surveys, involving selecting answers and submitting. While the provided code specifically implements `Poll` functionality, the conceptual workflow of taking a survey (as an 'item' with a deadline) suggests that polls and surveys might share underlying architectural patterns or user experience flows, even if implemented with distinct models (e.g., `Survey` vs. `Poll::Poll`). The RAG context mentions a 'survey item with questions and answers' and 'item deadline', indicating that surveys are likely integrated into the broader `Item` concept within the Xikolo platform, similar to how quizzes are handled.

**Technical Debt:**
The `app/views/dashboard/_polls.html.slim` partial uses direct jQuery `$.get` and DOM manipulation (`$('#polls').html(data)`) for loading poll content [Source: app/views/dashboard/_polls.html.slim]. While functional, this approach is less aligned with modern frontend practices, especially in a project that also leverages `ViewComponent` and `React`. Refactoring this into a dedicated ViewComponent or a React component could improve maintainability and consistency with the overall frontend architecture.

PollsController.description: Handles user interactions with polls, including fetching the next available poll, processing votes, and displaying poll archives. It ensures users are logged in and sets no-cache headers.

interactions.interaction_1: Interacts with `Poll::Poll` model to fetch, find, and process votes.
interactions.interaction_3: Uses `Dashboard::Poll::Question` for displaying poll questions and options.

class PollsController < Abstract::FrontendController
  before_action :set_no_cache_headers
  before_action :ensure_logged_in

def next
    poll = Poll::Poll.upcoming_for_user(current_user.id).first!

    render Dashboard::Poll::Widget.new(poll).with_content(
      Dashboard::Poll::Question.vote(poll).render_in(view_context)
    ), layout: false
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
    head :no_content
  end

def vote
    poll = Poll::Poll.find(params[:id])
    response = poll.vote! choices, user_id: current_user.id

    has_next_poll = Poll::Poll.upcoming_for_user(current_user.id).exists?

    render Dashboard::Poll::Widget.new(poll).with_content(
      Dashboard::Poll::Thanks.new(
        poll,
        choices: response.choices,
        stats: poll.reveal_results? ? poll.stats : nil,
        next_pol...

private

    def ensure_logged_in
      return true if current_user.logged_in?

      head :forbidden
    end

Poll::Poll.description: Represents a poll or survey. This model manages poll questions, options, user responses, and statistical data. It includes business logic for determining upcoming polls, processing votes, and controlling result visibility.

interactions.interaction_2: Interacts with `User` to track votes and responses.

module Poll
  class Poll < ::ApplicationRecord
    validates :question, :start_at, :end_at, presence: true
    # NOTE: Use comparison with Rails 7
    validate do
      errors.add :end_at, :before_start_date if end_at.before? start_at
    end

    has_many :options, class_name: '::Poll::Option', dependent: :delete_all
    has_many :responses, class_name: '::Poll::Response', dependent: :delete_all

    class << self
      def started
        where(start_at: ...::Time.zone.now)
      end

      def current
        started.where('end_at > ?', ::Time.zone.now)
      end

      def upcoming_for_user(user_id)
        current.order(:start_at).where.not(
          id: ::Poll::Response.where(user_id:).select(:poll_id)
        )
      end

      def latest_first
        reorder(start_at: :desc, created_at: :desc)
      end
    end

    ## ROUTE HELPERS
    ## Ensure that Rails routing helpers can be used directly with Poll instances.

module Poll
  class Option < ::ApplicationRecord
    self.table_name = 'poll_options'

    validates :text, :position, presence: true
    validates :position, uniqueness: {scope: :poll_id}

    belongs_to :poll

    default_scope { order(position: :asc) }

    before_validation :ensure_position_has_value
    before_destroy :ensure_poll_is_open

    private

    def ensure_poll_is_open
      return if poll.start_at.future?

      errors.add(:poll, :open)
      throw(:abort)
    end

    def ensure_position_has_value

Dashboard::Poll::Thanks.description: Renders a confirmation or thank you message after a user has voted on a poll. It can optionally display poll results and indicate if another poll is available.

interactions.interaction_1: Receives `choices` (user's selections), `stats` (if results are revealed), and `next_poll` status.

codeBlocks.code:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Dashboard
  module Poll
    class Thanks < ApplicationComponent
      def initialize(poll, choices:, next_poll:, stats: nil)
        @poll = poll
        @choices = choices
        @next_poll = next_poll
        @stats = stats
      end

      private

      def reveal_results?
        @stats.present?
      end

      def summary
        if reveal_results?
          t(:'polls.widget.intermediate_results', participants: number_with_delimiter(@stats.participants))
        elsif @poll.show_intermediate_results?
          t(:'polls.widget.not_enough_participants', link: polls_archive_path)
        else
          t(:'polls.widget.poll_archive_link', link: polls_archive_path)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

workflows.description: When a user navigates to the dashboard, an AJAX request is initiated to fetch and display the next available poll for them to interact with. If no poll is available, no content is displayed.

A user selects one or more options for a poll and submits their vote. The system records the response, and then displays a confirmation message, potentially revealing poll results and indicating if another poll is available.

Users can access an archive of past polls. For each poll, the system determines whether to display results based on the poll's status and the user's participation, or provides informational messages if results are not yet available.

As described in the RAG context, this workflow involves a student interacting with a survey item within a course, selecting answers, and submitting the survey. This is conceptually similar to voting on a poll, but likely uses distinct models and potentially different UI components, integrated as a course 'item'.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1600 1800" width="100%">
  <title>Poll and Survey Creation and Response Workflows</title>
  <desc>
    A detailed SVG flowchart illustrating the business workflows for "Poll and Survey Creation and Response".
    Includes "View Next Available Poll", "Vote on a Poll", "View Poll Archive and Results", and "Take a Survey (Conceptual)".
    Each workflow shows process steps, decision points, and component involvement with specific method calls and models.
  </desc>

  <defs>
    <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
      <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#6C757D" />
    </marker>

    <!-- Common Styles -->
    <style>
      .title { font-family: 'Arial, sans-serif'; font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; fill: #343A40; text-anchor: middle; }
      .workflow-title { font-family: 'Arial, sans-serif'; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; fill: #343A40; text-anchor: middle; }
      .start-end { fill: #28A745; stroke: #218838; stroke-width: 2; }
      .process { fill: #F8F9FA; stroke: #6C757D; stroke-width: 2; }
      .decision { fill: #FFC107; stroke: #E0A800; stroke-width: 2; }
      .component-frontend { fill: #007BFF; stroke: #0056B3; stroke-width: 1; }
      .component-controller { fill: #9b59b6; stroke: #7d3c98; stroke-width: 1; }
      .component-model { fill: #6C757D; stroke: #545B62; stroke-width: 1; }
      .component-service { fill: #FFC107; stroke: #E0A800; stroke-width: 1; }
      .text-label { font-family: 'Arial, sans-serif'; font-size: 14px; fill: #343A40; text-anchor: middle; }
      .text-component { font-family: 'Arial, sans-serif'; font-size: 12px; fill: #FFFFFF; text-anchor: middle; }
      .line { stroke: #6C757D; stroke-width: 2; marker-end: url(#arrowhead); fill: none; }
      .line-dashed { stroke: #6C757D; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 5 5; marker-end: url(#arrowhead); fill: none; }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- Main Title -->
  <text x="800" y="50" class="title">Poll and Survey Creation and Response Workflows</text>

  <!-- Workflow 1: View Next Available Poll -->
  <text x="800" y="120" class="workflow-title">Workflow: View Next Available Poll</text>

  <!-- Start Node -->
  <ellipse cx="800" cy="180" rx="125" ry="35" class="start-end" />
  <text x="800" y="185" class="text-label">User Navigates<tspan x="800" dy="16">to Dashboard</tspan></text>

  <!-- Step 1: Frontend Initiates AJAX Request -->
  <line x1="800" y1="215" x2="800" y2="260" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="260" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="800" y="285" class="text-label">Initiate AJAX Request<tspan x="800" dy="16">for Next Poll</tspan></text>
  <rect x="950" y="275" width="180" height="30" class="component-frontend" />
  <text x="1040" y="295" class="text-component">app/views/dashboard/_polls.html.slim</text>

  <!-- Step 2: Controller Receives Request -->
  <line x1="800" y1="330" x2="800" y2="375" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="375" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="800" y="400" class="text-label">Receive Request</text>
  <rect x="950" y="390" width="180" height="30" class="component-controller" />
  <text x="1040" y="410" class="text-component">PollsController#next</text>

  <!-- Step 3: Controller Queries Model -->
  <line x1="800" y1="445" x2="800" y2="490" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="490" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="800" y="515" class="text-label">Query for Next Poll</text>
  <rect x="950" y="505" width="180" height="30" class="component-model" />
  <text x="1040" y="525" class="text-component">Poll::Poll</text>

  <!-- Decision: Is Poll Available? -->
  <line x1="800" y1="560" x2="800" y2="600" class="line" />
  <polygon points="800,600 890,650 800,700 710,650" class="decision" />
  <text x="800" y="650" class="text-label">Poll<tspan x="800" dy="16">Available?</tspan></text>

  <!-- Path: Yes, Poll Available -->

  <rect x="1010" y="615" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="1135" y="640" class="text-label">Render Poll Data</text>
  <rect x="1270" y="630" width="180" height="30" class="component-controller" />
  <text x="1360" y="650" class="text-component">PollsController#next</text>

  <line x1="1135" y1="685" x2="1135" y2="730" class="line" />
  <rect x="1010" y="730" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="1135" y="755" class="text-label">Display Poll</text>
  <rect x="1270" y="745" width="180" height="30" class="component-frontend" />
  <text x="1360" y="765" class="text-component">Dashboard::Poll::Widget</text>
  <rect x="1270" y="780" width="180" height="30" class="component-frontend" />
  <text x="1360" y="800" class="text-component">Dashboard::Poll::Question</text>

  <!-- Path: No Poll Available -->
  <line x1="710" y1="650" x2="590" y2="650" class="line" />

  <rect x="340" y="615" width="250" height="70" class="process" />

  <!-- End Node (converging paths) -->
  <line x1="1135" y1="800" x2="1135" y2="840" class="line" />

  <ellipse cx="800" cy="875" rx="125" ry="35" class="start-end" />
  <text x="800" y="880" class="text-label">End</text>

  <!-- Workflow 2: Vote on a Poll -->
  <text x="800" y="950" class="workflow-title">Workflow: Vote on a Poll</text>

  <!-- Start Node -->
  <ellipse cx="800" cy="1010" rx="125" ry="35" class="start-end" />

  <!-- Step 1: User Selects Options -->
  <line x1="800" y1="1045" x2="800" y2="1090" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="1090" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="800" y="1115" class="text-label">Select Options</text>
  <rect x="950" y="1105" width="180" height="30" class="component-frontend" />
  <text x="1040" y="1125" class="text-component">Dashboard::Poll::Widget</text>
  <rect x="950" y="1140" width="180" height="30" class="component-frontend" />
  <text x="1040" y="1160" class="text-component">Dashboard::Poll::Question</text>

  <!-- Step 2: User Submits Vote -->
  <line x1="800" y1="1160" x2="800" y2="1205" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="1205" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="800" y="1230" class="text-label">Submit Vote</text>

  <!-- Step 3: Controller Receives Vote -->
  <line x1="800" y1="1275" x2="800" y2="1320" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="1320" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="800" y="1345" class="text-label">Receive Vote</text>
  <rect x="950" y="1335" width="180" height="30" class="component-controller" />
  <text x="1040" y="1355" class="text-component">PollsController#vote</text>

  <!-- Step 4: Record Response -->
  <line x1="800" y1="1390" x2="800" y2="1435" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="1435" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="800" y="1460" class="text-label">Record Response</text>
  <rect x="950" y="1450" width="180" height="30" class="component-model" />
  <text x="1040" y="1470" class="text-component">Poll::Response</text>
  <rect x="950" y="1485" width="180" height="30" class="component-model" />
  <text x="1040" y="1505" class="text-component">Poll::Poll</text>

  <!-- Step 5: Determine Display -->
  <line x1="800" y1="1505" x2="800" y2="1550" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="1550" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="800" y="1575" class="text-label">Determine Results/Next Poll</text>

  <!-- Step 6: Render Confirmation/Results -->
  <line x1="800" y1="1620" x2="800" y2="1665" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="1665" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="800" y="1690" class="text-label">Render Confirmation/<tspan x="800" dy="16">Results</tspan></text>

  <!-- Step 7: Display Confirmation/Results -->
  <line x1="800" y1="1735" x2="800" y2="1780" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="1780" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="800" y="1805" class="text-label">Display Confirmation/<tspan x="800" dy="16">Results</tspan></text>
  <rect x="950" y="1795" width="180" height="30" class="component-frontend" />

  <!-- End Node -->
  <line x1="800" y1="1850" x2="800" y2="1895" class="line" />
  <ellipse cx="800" cy="1930" rx="125" ry="35" class="start-end" />
  <text x="800" y="1935" class="text-label">End</text>

  <!-- Workflow 3: View Poll Archive and Results -->
  <text x="800" y="2005" class="workflow-title">Workflow: View Poll Archive and Results</text>

  <!-- Start Node -->
  <ellipse cx="800" cy="2065" rx="125" ry="35" class="start-end" />
  <text x="800" y="2070" class="text-label">User Accesses<tspan x="800" dy="16">Poll Archive</tspan></text>

  <!-- Step 1: Frontend Initiates Request -->
  <line x1="800" y1="2105" x2="800" y2="2150" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="2150" width="250" height="70" class="process" />

  <!-- Step 2: Controller Receives Request -->
  <line x1="800" y1="2220" x2="800" y2="2265" class="line" />
  <rect x="675" y="2265" width="250" height="70" class="process" />
  <text x="800" y="2290" class="text-label">Receive Archive Request</text>
  <rect x="950" y="2280" width="180" height="30" class="component-controller" />
  <text x="1040" y="2300" class="text-component">PollsController#archive</text>

  <!-- End Node (converging paths) -->
  <line x1="1135" y1="2690" x2="1135" y2="2730" class="line" />
  <polyline points="465,2690 465,2730 800,2730" class="line" />
  <ellipse cx="800" cy="2765" rx="125" ry="35" class="start-end" />

  <!-- Workflow 4: Take a Survey (Conceptual) -->

  <!-- Start Node -->

  <!-- Step 1: Frontend Displays Item -->
